title: Microarray analysis of gene expression
protocol: Isolate total hippocampal RNA from individual animals using RNA Aqueous, Ambion.
Determine RNA quality by measuring optical density values at 260/280 nm. Values should be consistently at or over 1.9.
Use five micrograms of total RNA and reverse-transcribe into cDNA.
Indirectly label the cDNA using a sensitive fluorescent labeling procedure from Genisphere.
Hybridize the chip to cDNA overnight following a two-step hybridization protocol.
Wash the chip stringently to remove nonspecifically bound probe.
Poststain the chip with fluorescent dendrimers after washing.
Scan slides using a GenePix scanner (Axon Instruments).
Import resulting files from GenePix 4.0 analysis into Genespring 5.0 for additional visualization and data mining.
Consider hybridization spots as positive if there is a signal intensity of twice the background or more in at least one channel of half of the replicates.
Perform per-chip normalization by dividing expressed genes by the median of two housekeeping control genes, β-tubulin and cyclophilin.
Determine gene regulation by taking the log ratio of the median experimental (running) channel signal to the median control (sedentary) channel signal.
Define up-regulated genes as having an average expression ratio of >1.3.
Define down-regulated genes as having an average expression ratio of <0.7.
Perform homotypic hybridizations where the same sample is hybridized in both channels (cy3 & cy5).
Determine cutoff levels consistent with expected gene regulation levels in brain tissue.
Perform statistical analysis by an unpaired t test using the cross-gene pooled error method.
Classify significantly regulated genes into relevant functional categories.
